name: AbbVie
description: AbbVie sells branded prescription drugs and Botox-based aesthetics products, and reports as one segment. It separated from Abbott Laboratories (the 10-K refers to AbbVie's separation from Abbott); Humira, the anti-inflammatory injection, was $14.4B of $54.3B revenue in FY2023. Humira revenue fell 49 percent in 2025 to $4.5B after biosimilars arrived, and the company has replaced it with two successors, Skyrizi and Rinvoq, which together were $25.9B (42 percent) of 2025 revenue. Payers, pharmacy benefit managers and government programs ultimately pay for each prescription, so net price depends on rebates and Medicare rules. It also sells Botox (therapeutic and cosmetic), Juvederm fillers, Vraylar (psychiatry) and cancer drugs such as Imbruvica and Venclexta. It pays a dividend of $1.73 a quarter and spends heavily each year buying rights to outside drug candidates ($1.0B of acquired research and milestone expense in H1 2026).

gics.note: Merck is listed as Pharmaceuticals and AbbVie as Biotechnology in the same source although both sell branded prescription drugs. SEC SIC code 2834 (Pharmaceutical Preparations) for AbbVie.

hq.note: 1 North Waukegan Road, North Chicago, IL 60064 (10-K cover)

employees.note: Approximately 57,000 employees in over 70 countries; FY2025 10-K

businessLines.name: Immunology (Skyrizi, Rinvoq, Humira)
businessLines.how: Patients on chronic therapy take a prescription repeatedly (Skyrizi is a quarterly injection after induction doses, Rinvoq a daily pill); revenue is net price times prescriptions after PBM and government rebates, so it grows with new indications and market share.
businessLines.description: Skyrizi (IL-23 inhibitor; psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis), Rinvoq (once-daily oral JAK inhibitor for several inflammatory diseases) and Humira (older injection, now facing biosimilars).

revenue.note: Computed sum: Skyrizi 17,562 + Rinvoq 8,304 + Humira 4,540; AbbVie does not report an 'immunology' subtotal in the tables read

businessLines.revenueNote: Computed sum: Skyrizi 17,562 + Rinvoq 8,304 + Humira 4,540; AbbVie does not report an 'immunology' subtotal in the tables read

businessLines.name: Neuroscience
businessLines.how: Chronic prescriptions paid by insurers and Medicare Part D (Vraylar, Ubrelvy, Qulipta) and buy-and-bill injections paid mainly by medical benefit (Botox Therapeutic, given every few months by a physician).
businessLines.description: Vraylar (schizophrenia, bipolar and depression), Botox Therapeutic (chronic migraine and other neurological uses), Ubrelvy and Qulipta (migraine), Vyalev (Parkinson's), and others.
businessLines.revenueNote: No neuroscience subtotal read; products sum (Vraylar 3,621 + Botox Therapeutic 3,769 + Ubrelvy 1,271 + Qulipta 1,036 + Vyalev 482 + other 381+207 unlabelled rows) was not verified line by line

businessLines.name: Oncology
businessLines.how: Oral cancer pills (Imbruvica, Venclexta) sold per prescription and infused or injected products (Elahere, Epkinly) sold to hospitals and clinics; Imbruvica and Epkinly show a separate collaboration-revenue line in the product table, meaning partner arrangements.
businessLines.description: Imbruvica, Venclexta, Elahere (from the January 2024 ImmunoGen acquisition), Epkinly (Genmab collaboration revenue) and others. The 10-K discloses collaborations with Janssen and with Genentech (Note 6).

businessLines.name: Aesthetics (Botox Cosmetic, Juvederm and others)
businessLines.how: Physicians and aesthetic practices buy toxin and filler product and patients pay out of pocket, so revenue follows consumer discretionary demand; AbbVie runs a customer loyalty program that changes net price.
businessLines.description: Botox Cosmetic, Juvederm dermal fillers, and other aesthetics (Alloderm, CoolSculpting, Natrelle breast implants, SkinMedica, Latisse), from the Allergan acquisition.

revenue.note: Computed sum: Botox Cosmetic 2,602 + Juvederm 993 + other aesthetics 1,265

businessLines.revenueNote: Computed sum: Botox Cosmetic 2,602 + Juvederm 993 + other aesthetics 1,265

businessLines.name: Other key products and eye care
businessLines.how: Mature prescription products sold per prescription; some are shared with partners.
businessLines.description: The 10-K lists other key products for hepatitis C, exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, hypothyroidism and IBS-C/chronic constipation (Linzess/Constella), plus eye care (Ozurdex $493M FY2025 and others).

brands.name: Humira
brands.share: 7.4% of FY2025 revenue ($4,540M), down from 25.2% in FY2023 ($14,404M of $54,318M)

brands.name: Allergan
brands.segment: Acquired subsidiary (aesthetics, eye care, neuroscience, opioid litigation)

whatsNext.text: FDA issued a Complete Response Letter on the Boey (trenibotulinumtoxinE) BLA in April 2026; the European Commission approved Boey in July 2026
